|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| [Hypothesis] | [0-1] | [0-1] | [0-1] | [0-1] | [Monitor / research / prototype / pilot / scale / hold] |

## Review rule

Do not assign high commitment to low-confidence, low-evidence, low-reversibility hypotheses without safeguards.
